newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks firm, Pliva forges ahead.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks firm, Pliva forges ahead.

text.p: Croatian stocks were stable to higher in quieter post-holiday trade on Thursday with drugs firm Pliva forging ahead after a share split.
* Six of 10 traded issues rose and four were unchanged.
* Volume 5,026 units, turnover lower at 1.7 million kuna.
* Biggest gainer was Istraturist, firming 7.69 percent to 140 kuna from a fortnight ago on volume of 50 shares.
* Most active, fully-listed Pliva, closed 3.86 percent up at 393 kuna on volume of 2,701 units after its shares were split at 37 for one on January 1.
